note: Hand-labelled. Tool cards are written the way Toolforge describes tools it forges; queries the way its planner phrases needs (name_hint + description). Negatives are needs no listed tool satisfies, several of them deliberate near-misses of a real tool.

tools.name: date_difference_in_days
tools.description: Absolute number of days between two ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: business_days_between
tools.description: Count the weekdays (Monday to Friday) between two ISO dates, excluding weekends.

tools.name: day_of_week
tools.description: Return the English weekday name (e.g. Monday) for an ISO date.

tools.name: add_days_to_date
tools.description: Return the ISO date that is a given number of days after (or before, if negative) a date.

tools.name: age_in_years
tools.description: Whole years elapsed between a birth date and a reference date.

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Convert a length, mass or volume value between metric and imperial units (km, mi, kg, lb, l, gal, ...).

tools.name: convert_temperature
tools.description: Convert a temperature between Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin.

tools.name: is_prime
tools.description: Return true if an integer is a prime number.

tools.name: nth_prime
tools.description: Return the n-th prime number (1-indexed: nth_prime(1) = 2).

tools.name: prime_factors
tools.description: List the prime factorisation of a positive integer, with repetition.

tools.name: gcd
tools.description: Greatest common divisor of two integers.

tools.name: lcm
tools.description: Least common multiple of two positive integers.

tools.name: int_to_roman
tools.description: Convert an integer from 1 to 3999 to a Roman numeral string.

tools.name: roman_to_int
tools.description: Parse a Roman numeral string and return its integer value.

tools.name: compound_interest
tools.description: Final amount of an investment with compound interest: principal, annual rate, compounding periods per year and years.

tools.name: simple_interest
tools.description: Simple (non-compounding) interest earned on a principal at an annual rate over a number of years.

tools.name: loan_emi
tools.description: Equated monthly instalment (EMI) for a loan given principal, annual interest rate and tenure in months.

tools.name: count_vowels
tools.description: Count the vowels (a, e, i, o, u) in a text, case-insensitively.

tools.name: word_count
tools.description: Count the words in a text, splitting on whitespace.

tools.name: is_palindrome
tools.description: Check whether a text reads the same backwards, ignoring case, spaces and punctuation.

tools.name: levenshtein_distance
tools.description: Levenshtein edit distance: minimum single-character insertions, deletions and substitutions to turn one string into another.

tools.name: jaccard_similarity
tools.description: Jaccard similarity between the sets of words in two texts (intersection over union).

tools.name: sha256_hex
tools.description: SHA-256 digest of a UTF-8 string as a lowercase hexadecimal string.

tools.name: md5_hex
tools.description: MD5 digest of a UTF-8 string as a lowercase hexadecimal string.

tools.name: base64_encode
tools.description: Encode a UTF-8 string as Base64 text.

tools.name: fibonacci
tools.description: Return the n-th Fibonacci number (fibonacci(0) = 0, fibonacci(1) = 1).

tools.name: factorial
tools.description: Factorial n! of a non-negative integer.

tools.name: mean_median_mode
tools.description: Summary statistics of a list of numbers: mean, median and mode.

tools.name: standard_deviation
tools.description: Population or sample standard deviation of a list of numbers.

tools.name: percentage_change
tools.description: Percentage change from an old value to a new value.

tools.name: bmi
tools.description: Body-mass index from weight in kilograms and height in metres.

tools.name: compound_annual_growth_rate
tools.description: CAGR: the constant yearly growth rate that takes a start value to an end value over a number of years.
